question: The secretion of HCl in the stomach can be stated that:

options.opd: Increase by a pH less than 2 in the stomach.

analysis: The secretion of HCl in the stomach is regulated by various factors. Vagal stimulation can increase the secretion of HCl, so it is not decreased by vagal stimulation. Histamine, acting on H2 receptors, can increase the secretion of HCl, so it is not decreased by histamine administration. Gastrin, a hormone released by the stomach in response to food, can also stimulate the secretion of HCl, so it is increased by gastrin action. A pH less than 2 in the stomach can trigger a negative feedback mechanism to decrease further HCl secretion.
